correctness.rationale: All \(2^{18}\) vertex subsets checked by independent union-find and edges-minus-components tests; 204492 allowed faces. An explicit complete augmented toggle matching has 102223 pairs and 43 critical 10-faces plus 3 critical 11-faces; the entire directed face poset with 1704456 incidence arrows passes topological sorting. The integral 3x43 signed Morse differential has a unit minor on columns 6,9,11 and the 10-sphere attaching maps are classified by integral degrees; the result is a wedge of 40 ten-spheres. All 216 graph automorphisms are enumerated and their class characters computed, with an independent signed simplicial-chain trace implementation on class representatives.

evidence: Carnero Bravo covers paths, cycles, double stars, cactus graphs, joins, and specified products, including P2 square Pk and K2 times Kn. Pappus is 3-regular with overlapping cycles, not cactus or complete multipartite; its edge set is not any of the listed product families. Taylan treats Pk-forbidden paths and chordal dominance, not terminal all-cycles complexes on Pappus.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Theorems were compared by their hypotheses and graph operations, not their titles. Neither general result specializes to the Pappus graph under the specific graph-family assumptions inspected.

evidence: Full Pappus matching-complex RESULT has 27 graph-edge vertices and face condition pairwise disjoint edges, resulting in degree-five homology. Our complex has 18 graph-vertex vertices and face condition cycle-free induced subgraphs, resulting in degree-ten homology. Pappus independence complexes include only vertex sets with no graph edges; no prior result states an extension equivalence to the forest complex.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of the inspected statements proves or forces the integral wedge of forty ten-spheres or the automorphism character on its forest homology. Shared underlying graph and 40-sphere count do not imply a homotopy equivalence; dimensions and face ground sets differ.

evidence: Induced-forest complex equals the all-cycles-devoid vertex complex and the terminal forest filtration complex. Taylan 2015 defines D(G,F); Carnero Bravo 2023 describes F_infinity(G) as acyclic vertex subsets. Neither inspected Pappus-specific evaluation was found.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The exact object is invariant under terminology changes: acyclic induced vertex sets and complements of feedback vertex sets. Both primary texts were read for same face condition; their stated families do not include the cubic Pappus Levi graph.

originality.rationale: Full primary-text inspection of Taylan and Carnero Bravo finds general devoid/forest-filtration methods and classifications of other graph families but no Pappus induced-forest result. Read the published Pappus ordinary matching-complex RESULT in full: it uses subsets of edges, not vertex-induced forests; even its 40-sphere multiplicity is not an implication. Pappus ordinary independence and intrinsic Cech results have different face predicates. Precise web and published-finding corpus queries for synonyms, graph identifiers and homology character found no dominating equivalent claim; absence from search is not a proof of novelty.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently named Pappus induced-forest homotopy calculation may exist.
A broader theorem not located by the available searches might imply the character.
No external independent mathematical validation has yet been performed.

value.rationale: The fixed Pappus Levi graph is canonical and its acyclic induced vertex subsets encode a natural decycling-set topology. An exact integral homotopy type is stronger than f-vector or field homology; the complete nontrivial automorphism character, including different traces on two order-three classes of identical vertex cycle type, adds meaningful symmetry structure not implied by homotopy ranks.
